The only "seen"-style flag in the data model is `WatchItem.watched`, so the contract is: remove every watchlist item with `watched === true`. This needs two units changed — the store (data + persistence) and the watchlist component (the button in the UI). I'll pin both down with acceptance tests.

input.reason: The request's "seen" flag maps to WatchItem.watched (the only such flag in the model). Clearing watched movies needs a new store operation (clearWatched, with persistence) and a button in the watchlist component UI wired to it. No other units are affected.

steps.instruction: Add a public method `clearWatched(): void` to the existing WatchlistStore class (all current members stay unchanged). Behaviour: remove every item whose `watched` flag is `true` from the watchlist, keeping the remaining unwatched items in their existing relative order. Update the `items` signal so the derived `count` and `watchedCount` signals remain correct, and persist the resulting list to localStorage under the existing storage key exactly the way `remove(id)` does. When no item is watched, calling it must be a harmless no-op (list unchanged). Do not change or remove any existing test; add your own tests in src/app/watchlist-store.spec.ts covering: removing only watched items, order preservation of remaining items, signal updates, persistence, and the no-op case.

Add a 'Clear watched' action to the watchlist UI, wired to the store's new `clearWatched()` method (WatchlistStore will gain `clearWatched(): void` which removes all items with `watched === true`). In src/app/watchlist/watchlist.html add a `<button>` with `data-testid="clear-watched"` and a visible, human-readable label containing the words 'Clear watched' (an icon inside the button is fine; match your existing button markup/styles). The button must always render when the list is non-empty and must be disabled when `watchedCount()` is 0 (e.g. `[disabled]="watchedCount() === 0"`). Wire its click to a new public method `clearWatched(): void` on the Watchlist component. That method must: read the current number of watched movies (`this.store.watchedCount()`) before clearing, call `this.store.clearWatched()`, and set `announcement` to a message reporting how many watched movies were removed (e.g. 'Removed 2 watched movies.'), following your existing aria-live announcement pattern. Do not change or remove any existing test; add your own tests in src/app/watchlist.spec.ts for the button and the method.
